notes: Run with the formdes engine running (MCP connected, or the API on 127.0.0.1:8196).

evals.name: ramen-menu-template
evals.prompt: formdes has no good menu for my ramen bar. Make an A4 portrait menu template: a big name at the top, three sections (ramen, small plates, drinks) with five priced items each, a photo and an allergens line at the bottom.
expected_behavior: The spec uses category print, kinds menu, A4 with bleed and medium print
Item frames use item1.title, item1.body, item1.price style slots and sections use section1 to section3
validate_template is run and its page image looked at before save_template
The saved template appears in list_templates and validates with no overset

evals.name: new-banner-size
expected_behavior: unit px, medium screen, kinds ad-banner, a headline, a line, a button and a logo with fit
Type sizes suit a 250 px tall banner (headline about 32 to 48 px)
The id starts with ad- and is not a built-in id

evals.name: fill-not-create
evals.prompt: Use the newsletter template to lay out these three articles
expected_behavior: No new template is created; the request is handed to the formdes-harness skill's intake and make_layout flow
